sampling: One continuous jointly shuffled concatenated real+synthetic pool. Cycle-fill across batch and epoch boundaries. Every image equally likely; full-pool traversal before reshuffle. No 8+8 source quota.
loss: 2*(n_syn/16*original_syn_branch_mean+n_real/16*original_real_branch_mean). Preserve original valid-channel/pixel normalization within each branch. Empty branches contribute zero. At 8+8 exactly the original sum, including variable masks. This is not a newly normalized per-image masked loss.
seed_interpretation: Three R2 sampling/augmentation seeds conditional on the same original R1 weights, Adam state, scaler, and fixed pseudo-label/subset sets; not full-pipeline seed repetitions.
optimizer_accounting: 828 R2 optimizer.step calls from the frozen R1 state. Standard Adam skips parameters with grad=None, so final affinity-head counters legitimately lag on real-only batches. Validate every named parameter against its actual gradient-present update count; never fabricate gradients, parameter steps, or count skipped AMP updates.

evaluation.interval: percentile95 paired frame; conditional on fitted seeds
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: Final update828 for every condition; no evaluation selection
evaluation.comparator_C: New proportional C with the same R2 seed
evaluation.comparator_control: Historical shared synthetic control; contextual R1 history differs

storage: Preserve45 FP32 final state_dict checkpoints; only one active new optimizer resume. Delete only own active resume after committed final checkpoint+receipt validation.
constraints: No new teacher inference or pseudo-label filtering
No Git operations in dirty primary repository
Prior results retained; this follow-up is exploratory after inspecting prior results
